snippet.title: "WITHDRAWALS VR" Sneak Peak
snippet.description:
We’re back and we’ve finally got some real news. We ended up deleting the old version and rebuilding the entire game, so this is a total rework on a brand new project. We added weed and coke growing, currently we only have two ways to do it so far, it works lol. You can pack your product into bags, smoke spliffs, or get hammered on vodka with some realistic (atleast i think so) visual effects. We also added a new inventory system with a 6-slot backpack and hip slots. We also added a soundtrack (sorta) which SLAPSSS. Join the Discord to see more!

Discord - https://discord.gg/X6fGg299aw
